g.text: UMAP and labels are from the author deposit; final-paper cluster correspondence is unresolved. Blue: clusters 1/6; orange: clusters 10/12/14; grey: remaining clusters.
D–E: mouse points and means. F: nonzero deposited X; no back-transformation. These panels do not establish a transition or distinct intermediate state.
